hero.headline: Less office madness. More time for the craft.
hero.subheadline: Takumiro is your AI secretary. It monitors your emails, WhatsApp messages, and incoming calls — organises every customer request, chases missing details, and puts the right task in front of you at exactly the right moment. Nothing slips through. You always know what to do next.

problem.title: Customer requests get buried in the daily grind.
bullets: Tracking down info from WhatsApp threads wastes time
Missing photos and details delay appointments and quotes
Customer emails get lost in the daily office routine
Missing phone calls while I'm out doing the work
Admin work eats up time that belongs in the business
problem.consequenceLabel: Every missed inquiry is lost revenue.
problem.closingLine: Takumiro brings structure to customer communication so no inquiry gets lost.

solution.title: An AI agent that turns inquiries into work
solution.body: Takumiro receives customer inquiries, qualifies them, requests missing information, and prepares the next steps. Instead of scattered calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails, you get a clear overview of what has been done and what needs to happen next.

items.title: No more lost inquiries
items.body: Calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails are captured so no revenue opportunity slips through the cracks.

items.title: Missing info gets collected automatically
items.body: Takumiro asks customers for missing photos, measurements, or details before the job gets stuck.

items.title: Always know what's next
items.body: You see at a glance what happened last and which next step is still open.

items.title: Less admin work, more focus on the business
items.body: Less chasing, less searching, less chaos. More time for customers, your team, and real craft work.

workflow.title: How it works
workflow.intro: Here's how Takumiro works in the background for your business:

steps.title: A customer gets in touch
steps.body: The inquiry comes in by phone, WhatsApp, or email.

steps.title: Takumiro receives the inquiry
steps.body: The AI agent captures the request and gathers the key information about the job.

steps.title: Missing details are requested
steps.body: If something is missing, Takumiro automatically asks for it — photos, measurements, or further details.

steps.title: The next step is prepared
steps.body: Depending on the case, Takumiro prepares an appointment, a follow-up, or a quote.

steps.title: You stay on top of everything
steps.body: Instead of message chaos, you see clearly what has been done and what needs to happen next.

capabilities.title: What Takumiro specifically handles for you

items.title: Receiving customer inquiries
items.body: Takumiro captures new requests, even when no one can answer the phone or reply right away.

items.title: Qualifying inquiries
items.body: The AI agent understands the request and structures it so you can work with it immediately.

items.title: Asking follow-up questions automatically
items.body: Missing information is requested directly from the customer before time is wasted in the office.

items.title: Preparing appointments and quotes
items.body: Takumiro moves the job to the next logical step instead of just filing it away.

items.title: Turning communication into clarity
items.body: Calls, emails, and WhatsApp messages become a structured workflow.

points.title: Starts at the inquiry, not the job
points.body: Most tools only help once the job has been created. Takumiro starts earlier: directly at customer communication.

points.title: Not just capturing, but moving things forward
points.body: Takumiro doesn't just receive inquiries — it qualifies them, requests missing info, and prepares the next step.

points.title: Less office madness in daily life
points.body: Instead of digging through emails, calls, and WhatsApp threads, you get a clear structure for every job.

points.title: Fits into existing workflows
points.body: Takumiro is designed to take load off your business without requiring you to overhaul your entire software setup.

controlSafety.title: You stay in control
bullets: Every inquiry stays traceable
You can review and adjust content
The next step is always visible
Takumiro supports but never decides without you
controlSafety.closingLine: Takumiro works in the background, but your business always stays in the driver's seat.

items.a: Takumiro is designed for trade businesses that receive many customer inquiries by phone, WhatsApp, or email and want to reduce admin work in their daily operations.

items.q: Does Takumiro replace my existing trade software?
items.a: No. Takumiro starts earlier and helps you capture, qualify, and turn customer inquiries into clear next steps.
Takumiro is designed for inquiries by phone, WhatsApp, and email.

items.q: Can I still speak directly with my customers?
items.a: Yes. Takumiro supports your business in the background and makes sure nothing gets lost. Communication stays in your hands.

items.q: What's the biggest benefit of Takumiro?
items.a: Less office chaos, fewer lost inquiries, and more clarity about what needs to happen next.
